name: Posco Dx Company Ltd.
summary: Posco Dx Company Ltd. is a global provider of information and communication technology (ICT) solutions, primarily serving the construction and materials sectors. The company's expertise spans cutting-edge domains including the Internet of Things (IoT), cloud computing, big data analytics, and artificial intelligence (AI). Its diverse portfolio encompasses smart factory implementations, factory automation, bespoke software development, and comprehensive sales and engineering support. A key offering is PosFrame, an intelligent platform designed to gather both structured and unstructured production site data in real-time, leveraging advanced analytics and AI to achieve optimal process management. Beyond core solutions, Posco Dx delivers a suite of IT services, including strategic business and solution consulting, seamless system integration, and efficient IT outsourcing. Its cloud services cover everything from consultation and infrastructure setup to architectural design, alongside the delivery and integration of Software as a Service (SaaS) and Platform as a Service (PaaS) offerings. Furthermore, it manages smart data center operations and provides robust security services. The firm also specializes in end-to-end logistics automation, offering a full spectrum of services from consulting and design to facility construction, implementation, and ongoing operation for both distribution and manufacturing logistics, as well as baggage handling systems. Complementing these, Posco Dx develops intelligent safety solutions for industrial and construction environments. Its product range includes the customized air-cooled AC drive, PosDrive NX Series; smart controllers that merge PLC and HMI functionalities for automation systems; robotic process automation (RPA) tools; and Vision AI, a deep learning-based platform technology for automated image recognition and analysis via CCTV in factory and logistics settings. Founded in 1989 and headquartered in Pohang, South Korea, the company was previously known as Posco ICT Company Ltd. before rebranding to Posco Dx Company Ltd. in April 2023. It functions as a subsidiary of POSCO Holdings Inc.
